record.description_evidence:
Turn every idea into a stunning image with the power of multiple AI models.

Create original photos from text, transform existing images, and explore different visual styles—all in one easy-to-use app. Instead of relying on a single AI model, you can compare multiple options based on image quality, generation speed, style, and cost, then choose the perfect model for each creation.

CREATE IMAGES FROM TEXT

Describe what you want to see and let AI bring it to life. Generate realistic portraits, cinematic scenes, product visuals, illustrations, fantasy artwork, social media content, commercial images, and much more.

EDIT YOUR EXISTING PHOTOS

Upload an image and describe the changes you want. Add or remove objects, replace backgrounds, modify colors, improve details, change styles, adjust perspectives, redesign scenes, and create entirely new versions of your photos.

• Best Quality — for detailed, realistic, and accurate results
• Fastest — for quick image generation
• Lowest Cost — for everyday creations
• Latest Model — for cutting-edge AI capabilities
• Creative Styles — for unique artistic results
• Photo Editing — for precise image transformations

COMPARE AND CREATE

Quickly compare model quality, speed, capabilities, and visual styles before generating. Select the model that fits your goal instead of guessing which one to use.

EXPLORE ENDLESS STYLES

Create images in a wide variety of aesthetics, including:

• Photorealistic
• Cinematic
• Anime and cartoon
• Digital art
• Fantasy and sci-fi
• Vintage and retro
• Graphic design
• Product photography
• Fashion and portraits
• Architecture and interiors
• Social media and advertising visuals

POWERFUL AI PHOTO EDITING

Make complex edits using simple instructions. You can:

• Add new objects or elements
• Remove unwanted objects
• Replace or redesign backgrounds
• Modify people, faces, clothing, or hairstyles
• Change lighting, colors, and atmosphere
• Restyle an entire image
• Transform sketches into polished visuals
• Create variations of existing photos
• Change camera angles or perspectives
• Enhance details and overall appearance

MADE FOR EVERY CREATOR

Whether you are a designer, content creator, marketer, entrepreneur, photographer, artist, or simply exploring your imagination, the app gives you the tools to create professional-looking visuals in seconds.

No advanced editing experience is required. Just write your idea, choose an AI model, and generate.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

• Multiple AI image models in one app
• Text-to-image generation
• AI-powered photo editing
• Clear model categories and comparisons
• Fast and simple creative workflow
• Realistic, artistic, and commercial styles
• Easy image variations and transformations
• High-quality results for personal and professional use

From your first prompt to the final image, you stay in control. Compare models, experiment with styles, refine your ideas, and discover the best AI for every creation.

Start creating and transform your imagination into extraordinary images.

VifunAI is an innovative AI Video Generator and Photo Animator that transforms static images, portraits, and landscapes into high-quality, dynamic videos. Powered by advanced AI motion synthesis, it allows you to create natural, smooth, and cinematic visual effects with just a few taps.

- Weekly: $7.99/week
